question: What Distribution Reward rate should be used for sUSDC in every month of 2026?
answer:
**Short answer — the Atlas does not explicitly state a Distribution Reward rate for sUSDC for each month of 2026.**

What the Atlas does say (relevant documents)
- The standard Distribution Reward rate is 0.2% (annualized) on USDS and sUSDS balances:  
  > "The standard Distribution Reward rate is set at 0.2%. The Distribution Reward rate is annualized on all USDS and sUSDS balances associated with the relevant Reward Code."  
  [Distribution Reward Rate](/atlas/57384c49-e499-4c69-b22c-8e1f1dd34759)

- An additional 0.3% Boosted Distribution Reward becomes available starting January 2026, but may be discontinued at Sky Governance’s discretion:  
  > "An additional 0.3% Boosted Distribution Reward rate will be available starting January 2026 ... This Boosted Distribution Reward may be discontinued in the future at the discretion of Sky Governance."  
  [Boosted Distribution Reward Rate](/atlas/1d9219cb-9359-40de-96a0-ac60a8174c63)

Interpretation and caveats
- The two documents above together imply that, for assets covered by those rules, the annualized rate would be 0.2% ordinarily and add an extra 0.3% from January 2026 while the Boost is in effect (i.e., 0.5% annualized while the Boost applies).
- HOWEVER, the Atlas excerpts retrieved do not mention sUSDC by name in the Distribution Reward rules. Because the Distribution Reward doc explicitly references USDS and sUSDS, but not sUSDC, the Atlas is silent about whether sUSDC is covered by the same reward-code/rate rules. Therefore the concrete answer for "sUSDC in every month of 2026" is not available in the Atlas material retrieved here.

If you want a definitive operational rate for sUSDC in 2026, the Atlas evidence suggests two possibilities:
- If sUSDC is treated the same as the sUSDS category referenced in the rule: 0.2% annualized base + 0.3% boost starting Jan 2026 (0.5% annualized) while the Boost remains active ([Distribution Reward Rate](/atlas/57384c49-e499-4c69-b22c-8e1f1dd34759), [Boosted Distribution Reward Rate](/atlas/1d9219cb-9359-40de-96a0-ac60a8174c63)).
- If sUSDC is not covered by those documents, the Atlas provides no authoritative monthly 2026 rate for sUSDC.

Sources
- [Distribution Reward Rate](/atlas/57384c49-e499-4c69-b22c-8e1f1dd34759) (UUID: 57384c49-e499-4c69-b22c-8e1f1dd34759)  
- [Boosted Distribution Reward Rate](/atlas/1d9219cb-9359-40de-96a0-ac60a8174c63) (UUID: 1d9219cb-9359-40de-96a0-ac60a8174c63)
